title: Yen Surges to Three-Month Peak Amid US-Japan Intervention
summary: The yen surged to a three-month peak on Monday after the US and Japan launched a joint intervention to support the currency. The dollar pared its losses in response. The yen held steady during the New York trading session, following a sharp advance earlier in the day that sparked speculation of further intervention. The US and Japanese governments confirmed they carried out the rare joint operation late last week. Investors are watching for further intervention, which has caused the yen to firm up. Oil prices dropped, while stocks gained amid hopes for an Iran peace deal.
summary_points: The yen surged to a three-month peak on Monday
The dollar pared its losses in response to the US-Japan intervention
The US and Japanese governments confirmed they carried out a rare joint operation late last week
Investors are watching for further intervention, which has caused the yen to firm up
Oil prices dropped, while stocks gained amid hopes for an Iran peace deal
